title: Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>You are a Software Engineer looking to take your career and technical skills to the next level. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from <strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>We are seeking a strategic, highly commercial and growth-driven Chief of Staff to spearhead commercial expansion and high-priority strategic initiatives in the UK market. Sitting directly alongside the UK CEO, this role bridges establishing high-value institutional partnerships with executive-level project execution.</p> <p>This is a high-leverage commercial and sales-focused Chief of Staff role - not an internal, project management or administration-focused role. Moving beyond traditional sales or purely operational roles, this position is designed for a strategic partner. You will act as the UK CEO’s right hand contributing to the long-term strategy, originating institutional partnerships and owning cross-functional strategic projects with the CEO end-to-end. A core element of this role is driving commercial growth alongside the UK CEO. leadership.</p> <p><br><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <h4><strong>Strategic Business Development & Commercial Growth</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Market & Commercial Strategy: Act as the local institutions across the UK.</li> <li>Executive Sales Support: Partner directly with the UK CEO on complex commercial partnership negotiations.</li> <li>Deal Structuring & Financial Modeling: Evaluate commercial frameworks, conduct quantitative modeling, and negotiate terms for strategic accounts and commercial initiatives.</li> </ul> <h4>Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Execution</h4> <ul> Roadmap Alignment: Collaborate with Group product and operational teams to champion UK commercial priorities and integrate required features into the product roadmap.</li> <li>Structured Execution: Maintain rigorous documentation, project cadences, and operational alignment across all UK strategic priorities while navigating Risk, Compliance, and Legal clearance for new commercial structures.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <p><strong>Qualifications & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A background in Investment Banking (especially FIG), M&A Advisory, Corporate Finance, Consulting or Strategic BD experience in financial services/fintech is highly desirable.</li> <li>Highly analytical and proactive mindset, avoiding reactive "firefighting" in favor of methodical, structured, data-backed execution and strategic planning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Skills & Core Competencies</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strategic acumen: strong commercial instincts and a thorough appreciation for UK market dynamics.</li> <li>Commercial & Financial Rigour: Strong financial modeling, valuation, contract negotiation, and analytical skills honed in high-pressure presentation skills suited for Board level interaction and external partner pitching.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!</strong></p> <p>At Raisin, we description: Fire Alarm Service & Maintenance Engineer Field Based - Brighton & Hove & Local Catchment | Circa £35,000 + Benefits and Additional Earning Potential Company Overview: Firetecnics is one of London's most trusted, LPCB-certified fire safety companies, with one of the best reputations in the industry built up over more than 35 years. We are the go-to fire safety partner for residential and commercial property professionals, delivering fast, reliable solutions that ensure full compliance and complete peace of mind. As part of the Helix International Group, Firetecnics combines specialist fire-safety expertise with the capability and backing of a wider risk, compliance and technology group. We provide fire detection, installation, service, maintenance and wider compliance solutions, combining technical expertise with responsive, personalised customer service. Role Overview: Firetecnics is strengthening its regional Service & Maintenance capability and is looking for Fire Alarm Service & Maintenance Engineers based in and around Brighton & Hove. The role is designed around stronger local coverage, with engineers working predominantly within defined regional customer clusters rather than routinely travelling across the whole South East. Your core focus will be planned fire alarm servicing and maintenance, reactive fault-finding, diagnostics and remedial works. We are looking for engineers with credible hands-on fire alarm experience, a methodical approach to faults and the ambition to continue developing technically. We also want to broaden our engineering capability across AOV systems and emergency lighting. Previous experience is advantageous but not essential where you have the right fire alarm foundations and willingness to learn; training and support will be provided where required. Key Responsibilities: Service and maintain fire detection and alarm systems in accordance with BS 5839-1:2025, relevant standards and Firetecnics procedures, including planned testing and inspections. Attend reactive fault calls, diagnose system issues methodically and complete first-time fixes wherever reasonably possible. Use panel information, event histories, downloads, laptops and relevant software tools to support fault diagnosis and system interrogation. Identify defects and remedial requirements, completing appropriate small works, upgrades or repairs where required and within competence. Produce accurate engineer reports and compliance documentation, clearly communicating findings and recommended actions. Represent Firetecnics professionally with customers, residents, site teams and internal colleagues. Develop capability across AOV systems and emergency lighting, completing additional training and competency sign-off where required. Maintain appropriate van stock, tools and equipment, work safely and participate in the out-of-hours call-out rota when required. Qualifications & Experience: Hands-on fire alarm service and maintenance experience, with a sound understanding of planned servicing and fault diagnosis. Experience working with conventional and analogue addressable fire alarm systems. A logical, methodical approach to fault-finding and a willingness to develop greater technical independence. Ability to work responsibly on customer sites and take ownership of service activity within your level of competence. Comfort using laptops, diagnostic tools and manufacturer software, or the technical aptitude to develop this capability. Good understanding of BS 5839-1 and BS5839-6:2019+A1:2020 , strong reporting and customer communication skills, and sound Health & Safety judgement. Full UK driving licence. Desirable Experience: FIA training or an equivalent fire alarm qualification. Experience across manufacturers such as Advanced, Kentec, C-TEC, Ziton, Gent, Protec, Notifier, Morley or similar. Exposure to open and managed or closed-protocol systems, remedials, small works or commissioning. Experience with AOV systems and/or emergency lighting; where this is not already part of your skill set, training can be provided. Why Join Us This regional recruitment campaign is designed to build engineering capability closer to the customers and communities we support. The intention is for you to work predominantly within Brighton & Hove, reducing unnecessary long-distance travel and building greater familiarity with the sites and systems in your area. Occasional wider regional travel may still be required. The starting salary is circa £35,000, depending on experience and capability. We are also interested in stronger, more experienced engineers where their technical capability fits the requirement, with the overall proposition considered accordingly. The package includes a company vehicle and fuel card, overtime and out-of-hours call-out payments, technical and manufacturer training and development across fire alarms, AOV and emergency lighting. Wider benefits include private healthcare, a 4% matched pension, 4x salary life cover, 23 days holiday with the option to purchase more and Perkpal rewards and discounts. For the right individual, this is an opportunity to build greater technical breadth and independence within an established fire-safety business, while working closer to home and contributing to a growing regional Service & Maintenance operation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Department Description Allica Bank has won multiple recent Commercial Mortgage awards with the CM products being the main driver of lending in the Allica suite, the Commercial Mortgage products have now been well established for over 2 years and continue to grow at pace as a market leader. As part of the risk function within Commercial Mortgages, this role is critical to ensure we can deliver on our objectives in a safe manner. Role Description The purpose of the role is to underwrite borrowing requests received via a variety of channels, including online in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy and in accordance with the Banks asset portfolio (including but not limited to commercial mortgages, commercial investment loans, commercial loans against leasehold properties) . Principle Accountabilities Assess and underwrite direct credit loan applications within personal discretion, in line with the all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite policy and underwriting policies utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools. Produce clear, accurate and concise written documentation, making clear recommendations to the Credit team for loan application requests falling outside of personal discretion or outside of credit policy, escalating cases where necessary to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities. Manage and own the end to end application process, from initial enquiry to completion, liaising effectively with the panel solicitors in terms of required security instructions and ensure loans are appropriately documented and borrowing is fully secured before draw-down. Liaise with the Credit team as required in managing the credit risk environment, concentration risk and developing credit policy. Undertake regular checks and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times; escalating immediately any areas of concern Manage a portfolio of advances to a defined arrears and collections policy. Liaise effectively with applicants (or their brokers) and valuers in requests for additional relevant information to support the credit decisioning process. Deliver an excellent service is given to customers, their brokers and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards. Ensure compliance with all mandatory policies and adherence to credit procedures to maintain internal credit controls. Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s. Help develop appropriate MI and KPI indicators and reporting, maintaining suitable MI to enable a detailed understanding of Mortgage processing pipeline Actively search for areas of improvement for the Bank and your team and take ownership for delivery of these, setting a good example by displaying appropriate values and behaviour Personal Attributes & Experience Exposure/knowledge of underwriting, with experience in the SME sector, with an understanding of the competitor landscape and the dynamics and trends of the SME market. Excellent credit/financial analysis skills including the analysis of financial accounts, budgets and cashflow forecasting, Understanding of the loan underwriting process and the risks involved and be able to assess applications within a personal discretion and make recommendations and take commercial decisions. Experience of escalating and presenting at Credit Committee level and Arrears Management. Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills. Ability to build strong and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders such as the distribution team, operations team and senior management, plus 3rd party suppliers such as Intermediaries, Valuers and Solicitors. Understand and comply with all regulatory requirements, plus internal policies / procedures, guidelines, risks and controls and service levels. Good understanding of TCF, AML, KYC and Conduct risk. title: Lead Data Scientist
description: <p><strong>The Role..</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a hands-on, generalist data scientist to own ML across all parts of our broad business, including Membership, Food & Beverage, Operations, Digital and Events.</p> <p>As Lead Data Scientist, you'll be the go-to expert for turning our vast datasets into predictive and prescriptive products that change how we run our Houses and serve our members, from predicting member churn and personalising what members see, to forecasting demand so our Houses are staffed well.</p> <p>You'll take models from idea to production and keep them performing, always looking for new ways to create value for our members and the business.</p> <p>You'll also raise the bar on how the wider analytics team measures impact, so decisions across the business rest on sound evidence.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities..</strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Machine learning products</span></p> <ul> <li>Own the design, build and continuous improvement of Soho House's ML portfolio, including member churn and segmentations, personalisation and recommendation engines (e.g. events), and demand forecasting for labour and operational planning</li> <li>Frame business problems with stakeholders, pick the right approach (which may not always be ML), and set clear success metrics tied to commercial outcomes</li> <li>Own the full model lifecycle: scoping, development, validation, deployment, monitoring, scheduled recalibration and retirement</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">ML Ops and production</span></p> <ul> <li>Set up ML Ops standards: version control, model registry, documentation and governance</li> <li>Work with Data Engineering to put models into production on our stack (GCP, Snowflake, Airflow), with reliable scoring pipelines and outputs that downstream tools and teams can use</li> <li>Build monitoring and observability for model accuracy in production (tracked against agreed thresholds and baselines), data drift and business impact, with clear alerts and review cycles</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Advanced analytics and measurement</span></p> <ul> <li>Set the standard for advanced measurement across the wider analytics team, educating analysts and acting as their go-to expert for things like experimentation and causal inference, and finding pragmatic, robust alternatives when the ideal method isn't possible (e.g. where randomisation can't be done)</li> <li>Create reusable frameworks, templates and guidance so analysts can run sound tests and impact measurement on their own</li> <li>Coach and upskill analysts, supporting the wider goal of building data literacy across the business</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Stakeholders and delivery</span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Membership, Marketing/CRM, Digital, Operations and Finance to prioritise a roadmap of data science work by value</li> <li>Explain complex methods and uncertainty clearly to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership</li> <li>Direct and quality-assure work from offshore data science resources when workload requires: scope tasks, review code and models, and keep standards consistent</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Required skills and experience</span></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant hands-on data science experience (typically 5+ years) across a broad range of problem types, such as classification and propensity, recommendation, time-series forecasting, clustering and segmentation</li> <li>A track record of putting models into production and owning them afterwards, not just building prototypes</li> <li>Strong Python (our preferred language) and its data science ecosystem</li> <li>A deep grounding in statistics, experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, variance reduction, difference-in-differences, synthetic control or similar)</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder skills: can turn a vague business question into a well-framed problem and explain results in plain English</li> <li>Comfortable as a senior hands-on IC who can also set direction for others and review their work without line-managing them</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with a modern cloud data stack, ideally Snowflake (Snowpark, Cortex) and dbt</li> <li>Practical ML Ops experience, e.g. MLflow or similar, Git, CI/CD, containerisation, automated retraining and monitoring</li> <li>Experience with LLM and GenAI tools, both for your own development workflow and for data enrichment (e.g. classifying or extracting structure from unstructured text)</li> <li>Experience in hospitality, membership, subscription, retail or consumer businesses</li> <li>Experience coaching analysts or building a measurement or experimentation culture</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits..</strong></p> <p>Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to grow your career.</p> <ul> <li>Discounts at Soho House globally, as well as Soho Home and Cowshed</li> <li>Annual Every House Membership</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Private Health and Dental Care</li> <li>Cycle to Work Scheme/Season Ticket Loan</li> <li>In conjunction with Soho Impact, take 3 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice.</li> <li>Cookhouse & House Tonic: Our Cookhouse & House Tonic programmes offer unique food and drink trainings, events and opportunities to inspire and educate.</li> <li>Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: People and Workplace Executive
description: Healf is Europe's fastest-growing company. Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three. We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter. The next chapter is harder and more interesting. We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one. At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people. We're looking for an ambitious People Executive to help build an exceptional employee experience at Healf. This is an ideal opportunity for an exceptional graduate or someone early in their career who thrives on ownership, loves bringing order to fast-moving environments, and genuinely cares about creating a workplace where people can do their best work. You'll sit at the heart of the business, ensuring our office runs seamlessly, every new joiner has an outstanding experience, and our culture continues to scale as we grow. You'll constantly look for ways to improve processes, automate manual work, and raise the bar across every employee touchpoint. Where you'll make an impact Workplace: Create a workplace that is organised, energising and enables the team to perform at their best. Own the day-to-day running of the office, ensuring spaces, meeting rooms and equipment are always ready for use. Manage workplace technology, inventory and supplies, proactively identifying improvements before they become problems. Culture and Engagement: Launch initiatives that strengthen team connection, including buddy programmes, coffee chats and other engagement activities. Coordinate inspiring fireside chats, team meetings and internal events. Plan quarterly socials and wellbeing initiatives aligned to Healf's four wellbeing pillars. Gather feedback from employees and identify opportunities to improve the overall employee experience. What you'll bring Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail. Naturally proactive; you spot problems before anyone else does. Strong ownership mentality; you enjoy being trusted with responsibility. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Able to prioritise multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Curious and always looking for better ways of working. Confident working across different teams and building relationships. Strong administrative skills and comfortable learning new systems quickly. Positive energy and genuine enthusiasm for creating a great employee experience. Excited by working in the office five days a week and helping shape company culture in person. Nice to haves Previous internship or placement in People, Operations, Hospitality, Events or Customer Experience. Experience using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Humaans, and ai tools like Claude Code or Codex. Experience organising events or running projects. Experience improving processes or introducing automation. Passion for wellbeing, health or high-performance cultures. What makes someone exceptional in this role? We'd love to see examples of someone who has: Taken ownership of a university society, sports club or large-scale event. Built systems that made something run better. Naturally notices details that others miss. Loves hosting, organising and creating memorable experiences. Has high standards and dislikes leaving things "good enough." Learns incredibly quickly and actively seeks feedback. Brings energy to a room and enjoys helping others succeed. These behaviours matter far more than extensive experience. Our interview process 30 minutes with the Talent team 30 minutes with the People team 60 minutes case study with the People team 30 minutes with Lestat, Co-founder The Deal We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have. In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade. We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company. If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it. description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, you will own commercial contracting end to end as OLIX moves from a small legal team to a function that supports a rapidly scaling business. You will be the lead lawyer on some of our most important projects and largest and most complex deals, the person the business comes to to help them make clear and quick risk decisions and, as the company grows, you will have the opportunity to recruit team members. You will define the playbooks, standards, and tooling that let OLIX scale faster than legal headcount. This is a player-coach role for a technically excellent, experienced lawyer who wants to own a function in an environment accelerating and changing quickly, work hands-on with engineers and commercial leaders, and shape how commercial legal works at one of the most ambitious deep-tech companies in Europe. You will not be sitting above the work. You will be leading the toughest negotiations yourself, making judgement calls where the law, the facts, and the commercial picture are all still moving, and building the team that handles everything else. OLIX moves quickly, priorities shift, and there is often no precedent to lean on. You need to have worked in an environment like this before, or be able to show you would thrive in one. Open to UK-based candidates and US-qualified attorneys willing to relocate to London. We provide full visa sponsorship and relocation support. Responsibilities Lead the commercial legal function end to end: strategy, team, deal flow, tooling, and standards. Personally lead negotiations on OLIX’s largest and most complex commercial deals, including customer agreements with hyperscalers, manufacturing, and other supply chain agreements with contract manufacturing partners, NREs, JDAs, technology licences, and strategic partnerships. Build and scale the commercial legal team as OLIX grows. You will be hands-on as the main lawyer on your own projects from day one and, in time, hire, develop, and line-manage additional team members. Set commercial legal standards, playbooks, fallback positions, and templates across the function. Working with the CLO, make risk decisions, and help the business make them. Cut through ambiguity, frame legal and commercial risk in plain terms, recommend a position, and own the call, including where the facts, the law, or the commercial context are developing and moving quickly. Design and build scalable legal workflows using AI tooling and automation, so the legal function scales faster than headcount. Integrate AI deeply into day-to-day contracting: triage, first-pass review, redline generation, clause extraction, precedent search, and playbook enforcement. Set OLIX’s positions on key commercial terms including liability caps, indemnities, IP ownership and licensing, data protection, warranties, termination, and service levels. Own the IP dimension of commercial work: structure and negotiate IP ownership, background and foreground IP, licensing, confidentiality, and know-how provisions in JDAs, NREs, and manufacturing and supply arrangements, working closely with engineering and IP counsel to protect OLIX’s core technology, working closely with the CLO and other senior leaders to define and implement IP strategy. Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and Engineering to align legal with business strategy. Manage external counsel for specialist workstreams including US contracting, specialist IP, data, and export controls. Partner with the CLO and other team members on cross-functional matters including corporate, governance, and regulatory work that touches commercial contracting. Contribute to legal tooling selection, CLM implementation, and internal enablement across the broader legal team. Skills & Experience Qualified solicitor in England and Wales, or US-qualified attorney (admitted to a US state bar), guidance being at least 8 to 12 years of post-qualification experience. Trained at a top-tier City, US, or comparable international firm. Technically excellent lawyer. Rigorous legal analysis, precise drafting, and a structured approach to playbooks and standard forms. You know when precision matters and when speed does, and you are the person more junior lawyers check their work with. Demonstrable track record leading complex commercial contract negotiations end to end as the responsible lawyer, not just supporting a partner, and of being the main lawyer on multi-workstream projects (a manufacturing ramp, a major customer deployment, a strategic partnership) rather than on a single contract. Technical IP experience. You have negotiated IP ownership, background and foreground IP, licensing, confidentiality, and know-how provisions in technology development, manufacturing, and supply arrangements (JDAs, NREs, foundry and supply agreements), ideally involving semiconductors, hardware, or other deep technology. You do not need to be a patent attorney, but you need to understand what is being created and licensed and how to protect it. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making risk decisions. You can take an incomplete picture, work out what matters, give a clear recommendation, and own it. You help the business make good risk calls rather than handing it a list of issues. Proper, relevant experience of an environment like OLIX: you have built, scaled, or meaningfully contributed to a commercial legal function in a fast-moving technology or hardware business, ideally a venture-backed scale-up, working directly with founders, engineers, and commercial teams. Line-management or mentoring experience with junior counsel, paralegals, or secondees. Does not need to be extensive but needs to be real, and you want to manage and grow a team as the function scales. Comfortable with technical subject matter. You can get to grips with OLIX’s technology well enough to draft and negotiate around it credibly and to hold your own with engineers. AI-native approach to legal work. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day practice, have strong instincts for what AI does well and where it fails, and treat AI fluency as a core craft skill rather than a novelty. Bias toward building scalable systems over doing work manually. You look for the automation, template, or workflow that solves the problem ten times, not just once. Commercially pragmatic, able to move at pace, and comfortable owning positions without constant supervision. Direct, plain-language communicator. The right fit for how OLIX works: hands-on, direct, high ownership, and comfortable being part of the team rather than a gatekeeper. You would rather solve the problem than write the memo. Nice to have Experience in technology or in technical manufacturing more broadly, ideally B2B hardware, semiconductors, or infrastructure. Highly desirable. Supply chain experience: supply, manufacturing, component, and logistics arrangements, and the issues that come with scaling a hardware supply chain (capacity and volume commitments, allocation, lead times, quality, tooling, dual-sourcing). Highly desirable. Familiarity with enterprise or cloud customer contracting, including bespoke negotiations with hyperscalers. Understanding of export controls (particularly the US and UK regimes for advanced computing and semiconductors) and data protection as they arise in commercial contracts. Experience implementing or selecting CLM or legal AI tooling (Ironclad, Harvey, Legora, Spellbook, Robin, Eve, etc.). Light coding or low-code fluency (Python, SQL, Zapier, n8n, or similar) for building internal workflows. Compensation & Equity Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer GAIA
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Simulation Teams You'll be joining the Simulation team (Simulation Evaluation & Validation), working on Gaia — Wayve's world model. Gaia is trained on large-scale driving video to predict future frames from past context, functioning as a simulator that generates synthetic scenarios and operates in closed loop with the driving model itself. The team partners closely with Research, Applications, Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure to turn model improvements into measurable downstream impact on the driving stack. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own and lead parts of large-scale training for Gaia (language- or video-style training at scale), from experimentation through productionised training runs. Contribute to and influence model architecture decisions — not just applying existing models. Partner across sub-teams: Research (model development), Applications (adapting models to use cases), Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure. Translate product and evaluation needs into model improvements (e.g. better long-horizon prediction, scenario generation quality, failure-case coverage). Mentor and set technical direction, raising the engineering and research quality bar across the team. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Leading and executing Gaia's post-training and closed-loop pipeline — fine-tuning and aligning the world model through post-training experimentation and targeted data curation. Pushing Gaia's autoregressive generation towards longer, more stable rollouts, and making the model deployment-ready (inference time and reliability included). Contributing to broader model architecture and training-strategy decisions where they intersect with pre- and post-training and the application layer. Partnering closely with research, applications, simulation engineering, and cloud/infrastructure teams to translate post-training improvements into measurable downstream impact. Providing technical leadership through mentorship, review, and setting high engineering/research standards. 🙌 You should apply if Essential: You have hands-on experience post-training/fine-tuning large-scale models (language, video, or other foundation models). You have experience with world models, autoregressive generation, and long-horizon generation. You have experience with diffusion/flow models and a solid understanding of 3D vision. You have a strong understanding of model architecture and can contribute meaningfully to architectural/training decisions. You have strong hands-on engineering skills with modern ML stacks (e.g. PyTorch), including debugging and performance/reliability-minded development. You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience (advanced degrees are valued, but depth of applied experience matters more). Desirable: Experience with inference optimisation or deploying large models under latency/compute constraints. Experience improving data/training pipelines and working across infrastructure constraints (distributed training, efficiency, reliability). Proven technical leadership — tech lead ownership, mentoring, or setting direction across an area. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews (Programming/Pytorch debugging and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total) Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total) Final interview : Mission & values alignment (45 mins). We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team: Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies. We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres, biotechs and MedTech companies to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges. About the role: This is a newly-created role for an individual who wants to take the next step in their technology consulting career and wants hone their skills and knowledge of end-to-end AI transformation. As a Senior Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our pharmaceutical clients. We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI solutions are optimised for real-world operations. #LI-PRIO What you'll be doing: Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions. Working side-by-side with life sciences stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams. Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team Who we're looking for: You have prior consulting experience delivering technical transformation projects You've worked in a Life Sciences company, or with Life Sciences clients You've worked alongside technical experts in Data Science / Machine Learning / Software engineering to scope, design and deploy a solution You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, keen to take initiative and own finding solutions to challenges Our interview process: Talent Team Screen (40 mins) Introduction Interview (60 mins) Case Study Interview (60 mins) Interview with Business Unit Director (30 mins) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI. title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p>At Monzo, our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. We’re looking for Senior Technical Program Managers to join our Engineering teams across Payments and Business Banking, helping us deliver complex, high-impact programmes as we continue to grow.</p> <p>Depending on the team you join, you could be:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Payments</strong>: helping us ship more and better payment products, working across teams to solve complex technical challenges and improve how money moves for millions of customers.</li> <li><strong>Business Banking</strong>: helping us build Monzo into the financial control centre for SMEs. You’ll work across teams to deliver features, services and integrations that make running a business simpler from invoicing and expenses to payments and automation.</li> </ul> <p>Both roles have a wide remit and involve working across engineering, product and other teams at Monzo. We’re looking for people who can bring clarity to complex technical programmes, influence across teams and help turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes for our customers.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of launching payment products that cross multiple teams and disciplines</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programs: <ul> <li>Define program roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers and speed up delivery</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience managing complex technology programs or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You are able to communicate clearly and persuasively to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership</li> <li>You are comfortable in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be a part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and identify/mitigate delivery risks proactively; can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data and architecture to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring for the <strong>Head of Financial Planning & Analysis</strong>, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team. You will play a key part leading our monthly business reviews and forecasting, annual planning, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment, as well as develop the long term roadmap for the FP&A team. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a proven record of leading a team to use data analysis to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.</p> <p>Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role in AMER or EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations</li> <li>Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment</li> <li>Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives</li> <li>Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence</li> <li>Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning</li> <li>Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting</li> <li>Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings</li> <li>Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team</li> <li>Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams</li> <li>Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record</li> <li>Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth </li> <li>Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities</li> <li>Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character</li> <li>Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects</li> <li>Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools</li> <li>Understanding of core accounting principles </li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments </li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience</li> <li>Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis</li> <li>Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish -Speaking  - London, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Deal Review - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission.
